author: Kai Moreno
title: Internal control review of Redwood infrastructure
content:
# Purpose
Once a year Security runs an internal control review of Redwood's own production accounts. Support should not file customer tickets against this page.

# Scope
Redwood AWS and GCP projects, on-call rotations, backup restore tests, and access reviews. Customer tenants are out of scope.

# If a customer writes in
If a customer asks how we review our own infra, point them at the public security page and assign the ticket to Legal as a questionnaire. Priority P4. Do not start an internal review because a customer asked.

# If an employee writes in
Employees use the Security intake form, not a SUP ticket. Close any SUP opened by an employee for this work and tell them to use the form.

# Scheduling
The 2026 review window is October. Support does not book it. Security owns the calendar.

# Outputs
A private findings doc in the Security space. Not a customer-facing export. Not a bucket in the customer's cloud.

# Related
Security annual calendar. Employee intake form. Not the customer-managed export SOP.
